categories.responsibility: CLI, composition, I/O adapters and loading

rules.complexity: Each function with body starts at 1; if, for/for-in/for-of, while, do, non-default case, catch, ternary, &&, ||, ?? and logical assignments add 1. Nested functions are separate. Top-level decisions start at 0. else, default, try and optional chaining add 0.
rules.lines: Normalize CRLF/CR to LF; final newline adds no physical line; code lines have non-whitespace tokens, excluding comments/trivia. AST literal ranges protect string, regex and template content during scanning.
